entities.name: Attach procedure
entities.description: Procedure during which UE indicates WUS assistance capability and may include UE paging probability information.

entities.name: Tracking area updating procedure
entities.description: Procedure during which UE indicates WUS assistance capability and may include UE paging probability information.

entities.name: Requested WUS assistance information IE
entities.description: Information element that may contain UE paging probability information provided by the UE during attach or tracking area updating.

entities.name: Negotiated WUS assistance information IE
entities.description: Information element containing the negotiated UE paging probability information provided by the network when accepting attach or tracking area updating.

entities.name: UE paging probability information
entities.description: Assistance information used to determine the WUS group for paging the UE. Negotiated between UE and network.

entities.name: UE attached for emergency bearer services
entities.description: Condition where UE is attached for emergency bearer services, which prohibits inclusion of UE paging probability information.

entities.name: Use of WUS assistance
entities.description: Property indicating whether UE and network can use WUS assistance based on negotiated information.

entities.name: PDN connection for emergency bearer service
entities.description: Procedure that, when established, suspends WUS assistance usage until emergency connection is released.

relations.description: Attach procedure may contain Requested WUS assistance information IE with UE paging probability information.
Tracking area updating procedure may contain Requested WUS assistance information IE with UE paging probability information.
Requested WUS assistance information IE may contain UE paging probability information.
UE shall not include Requested WUS assistance information IE when attached for emergency bearer services.
Network includes Negotiated WUS assistance information IE when accepting attach procedure.
Network includes Negotiated WUS assistance information IE when accepting tracking area updating procedure.
Negotiated WUS assistance information IE contains the negotiated UE paging probability information.
Receipt of Negotiated WUS assistance information IE establishes that UE can use WUS assistance.
Establishment of PDN connection for emergency bearer service suspends WUS assistance usage.
